admission.justification: The same raw-link defect crossed independent rendering owners, and row-click interception can break a rendered link even when markup looks correct.

applicability: Links inside task register cells, nested skip reasons, sprint row scope and graph edge reasons.
conditions: Link clicks in a register row follow the link without also opening that row.
The text is rendered Markdown at each named surface.
exclusions: Fixing shared relative-link routing outside these surfaces.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/page-look.test.tsx, group 'links (rule 10)'; dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/order-block.test.tsx: the edge's reason as a link; notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f6/sandbox/look2-capture.json (rawMarkdownLinks 0 on every form and width); the focused set of the reports: 331 passed in 40 files

statement: A Markdown link written in a register cell, in the reason of a skipped nested step, in the scope of a row of the sprint document or in the reason of an edge of the execution graph is drawn as a link, and a click on a link in a register row follows the link without opening the row.
